messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:
On Tue, May 20, 2025, Darrin Bath via AMBER wrote:
>
>I ran into an issue following the build install command (attached
>screenshot). No errors prior. I downloaded both Amber and AmberTools within
>the past week and was sure to run update_amber prior to ./run_cmake. I am
>trying to build it on a Linux system (Discovery HPC in Massachusetts), but
>idk if that would change anything. I could also try to build it on my Mac
>and see if there are similar issues with a different OS.
This is an odd result, seeming to have to do with the Perl installation
on your system.  One workaround is to add -DBUILD_PERL=FALSE to your
run_cmake script.  This should allow the build to get past the point at
which it failed, and would be OK unless you plan to use the FEW module.
...good luck...dac
